children: Tenable completed a private offering of $800 million of 0.25% convertible senior notes due 2031, entered into related capped call transactions to mitigate dilution, and repaid and terminated its 2021 Credit Agreement. The notes, convertible at an initial price of about $44.84 per share, provide funding for refinancing, share repurchases, and general corporate purposes. The capped calls, with a $64.06 per-share cap, are intended to reduce dilution or offset cash payments above principal on conversion. Proceeds were used to fund the capped calls, repurchase stock, and retire term loans under the prior facility.
Agreement 1: Tenable Completes $800 Million 0.25% Convertible Notes Offering Due 2031
: Indenture for 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee
: Refinance debt and fund corporate purposes
Agreement 2: Tenable Adds Capped Calls With $64.06 Cap to Reduce Dilution on Convertible Notes
: Capped call confirmations related to convertible notes
: Reduce dilution and offset cash above principal on conversion
Agreement 3: Tenable Repays Term Loans and Terminates 2021 Credit Agreement With JPMorgan
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and lenders
: Repaid term loans using note proceeds
